risk_note: RV2 (funds path, no money moves). went-negative's system rejection (W3 NEGATIVE_BALANCE, BR-WDR-10, BR-WDR-05; D10-619) wrote no audit record. It now writes one withdrawal_reject on the rejection's transaction, with system_actor system:payout, admin_id null. The rejection, its voucher and its amounts do not change; a withdrawal only blocked and a balance back at zero write none. createAuditWriter stores the actor in admin_id (uuid), so the record goes through admin's createSystemAuditWriter, which gains appendAction; the order hold's row does not change, pinned by #10. The check on audit_logs requires system:<name>, so the enum audit_system_actor gains system:payout (accepted by the orchestrator 18:29), with contracts/enums/admin.yaml, openapi and the generated files. The audit port is optional on the consumer because the frozen state/negative tests build it without one; the worker entry always passes it and the rule tests go through the real AppModule. The consumer runs in the worker as couli_app; the payout process's W9 only enqueues. Known, out of scope and reported: withdrawal_reject has no target rule in audit-log-view, so these rows, manual ones too, are not found by target_id; a mutation moving lockBalances off the transaction is caught only by a spy (AC-B2-05e#24).
